claims.value: A 3.35B parameter pretrained multilingual model optimized for West Asian and African languages, supporting 70+ languages.
claims.evidence: Best for West Asian and African languages... 3.35 billion parameter model optimized for efficient, strong, and balanced multilingual representation across 70+ languages
Tiny Aya supports a context length of 8K & 8K output length.
Input: Text only. Output: Model generates text.
The model's strongest performance is on open-ended generation... Chain-of-thought reasoning tasks such as multilingual math (MGSM) are comparatively weaker.
